description: This file defines FastAPI endpoints related to video operations, including creation, listing, status checking, downloading content, and remixing videos. It utilizes dependency injection, request parsing, and delegation to a request processing class, conforming to OpenAI-like video API specifications.

methods.name: video_generation( request: Request, fastapi_response: Response, input_reference: Optional[UploadFile] = File(None), user_api_key_dict: UserAPIKeyAuth = Depends(user_api_key_auth), )
methods.description: Handles POST requests for generating videos from text prompts using a specified model, delegating processing to ProxyBaseLLMRequestProcessing.

methods.name: video_list( request: Request, fastapi_response: Response, user_api_key_dict: UserAPIKeyAuth = Depends(user_api_key_auth), )
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve a list of videos, including support for custom provider selection.

methods.name: video_status( video_id: str, request: Request, fastapi_response: Response, user_api_key_dict: UserAPIKeyAuth = Depends(user_api_key_auth), )
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve the status and metadata of a specific video by ID, attempting to resolve the model from the ID and request context.

methods.name: video_content( video_id: str, request: Request, fastapi_response: Response, user_api_key_dict: UserAPIKeyAuth = Depends(user_api_key_auth), )
methods.description: Handles GET requests to download the content of a specific video by ID, returning raw video bytes with proper headers.

methods.name: video_remix( video_id: str, request: Request, fastapi_response: Response, user_api_key_dict: UserAPIKeyAuth = Depends(user_api_key_auth), )
methods.description: Handles POST requests to remix an existing video with new prompts, merging request body data and delegating processing accordingly.
